Power Dot France.rule: Only connector tariffs returned by the official Power Dot public ad-hoc API are overlaid; all unmatched or failed rows remain fail-closed.

WAAT.rule: Use only rows whose exact EVSE ID starts FR*WA2* and the tariff fields returned by Monta's public CPO pricing dataset. Never apply a site, operator or national fallback; every PAN EVSE absent from the public export remains fail-closed/unpriced.

Bouygues Energies & Services.rule: Use only exact PDC tariffs returned for PAN-matched Alize public-map locations. Do not infer a Bouygues-wide or sub-network-wide tariff. Any unmatched PDC, marker/detail error, or matched PDC without a returned price remains fail-closed/unpriced.

IZIVIA.source: IZIVIA public map / national physical pricing snapshot
IZIVIA.rule: Use only tariff text returned for the exact matched IZIVIA public-map station/location. Never substitute a national, network or power-band tariff when an exact station tariff is absent; every unmatched or unpriced PAN station/PDC remains fail-closed.

method: A CPO is counted treated only when an exact non-extrapolated tariff source has been made usable for at least a validated subset and all unresolved rows are explicitly fail-closed. A CPO is set aside only after official site/map, web bundles/APIs, public or guest endpoints/open data/EVSE IDs, useful third-party station services, and available mobile-app surfaces have been explored without obtaining a usable exact tariff source.
